It then ranks the available nodes and binds the pod to the most suitable node. This process is crucial for ensuring efficient resource utilization and optimal performance of applications within the Kubernetes cluster.

"}{end}' part formats the output using JSONPath. {range .items[*]} iterates over each pod. {..image} recursively searches for the image field within each pod's structure. This is crucial because the image field can be nested within different levels of the pod's specification (e.g., within containers, initContainers, or ephemeralContainers). The {"

This command also correctly retrieves container images, but it only considers the containers section of the pod spec. The `kubectl get` pods `-A` part fetches all pods across all namespaces. The -o=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{range .spec.containers[*]}{.image}{"
"}{end}{end}' part formats the output using JSONPath. {range .items[*]} iterates over each pod. {range .spec.containers[*]} iterates over each container within the spec.containers list of the pod. {.image} extracts the image name from each container. {"
